findings.summary: resp.tool_calls[0] unguarded: crashes with TypeError/IndexError when the model returns no tool calls in XAI_TOOLS mode
findings.failure_scenario: An xAI model in XAI_TOOLS mode returns a response where resp.tool_calls is None or empty list (model declined to call a tool or returned text instead). Accessing resp.tool_calls[0] raises TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable (async path line 97) or IndexError (sync path line 136). The diff now adds _raw_response assignment immediately after this unguarded access, re-exposing the pre-existing crash path.

findings.summary: validation_context is silently discarded in XAI_TOOLS path: None is hardcoded in _validate_model_from_json call
findings.failure_scenario: A user passes validation_context with additional data for model validation (e.g., a dict of reference values for cross-field checks). The xAI create function pops validation_context from call_kwargs at line 75 (async) / line 114 (sync) and discards it. Line 100 / 139 then passes None to _validate_model_from_json(response_model, args, None, strict). A model validator that relies on validation_context will receive None instead of the user-provided data, causing misleading validation failures or silently weakened validation.

findings.summary: create_with_completion is only tested with XAI_JSON mode, not XAI_TOOLS; the XAI_TOOLS path for create_with_completion has no test coverage
findings.failure_scenario: If XAI_TOOLS mode has a bug where create_with_completion returns wrong or missing _raw_response, existing tests won't catch it because test_xai_create_with_completion (line 167) and test_xai_create_with_completion_async (line 200) only use Mode.XAI_JSON. No test exercises the XAI_TOOLS path through create_with_completion.
